title.zh: SpaceX与特斯拉成立特别委员会，探讨合并可能性

current_state.zh: SpaceX and Tesla have each formed independent-director special committees to explore a potential merger, with Elon Musk recusing himself and noting that any deal would need approval from 50% of Tesla shareholders.
